actual_source_review.scope: Complete builder/diff and changed helper, owner reduction, scalar publication, host offset and Python allocation reads.

required_source_proofs: At most two distinct partial units per CTA/phase; same-unit contributes once; empty contributes none
Exact weighted range reconstruction and contributor enumeration
All stores before release count; acquire before owner reads; no counter/data reuse until safe
C++/host/Python scratch offsets and maximum sizes match
Explicit non-FTZ add and unchanged BF16/activation/finalizer boundaries
strongest_failure_case: Short/same-unit boundary range plus empty or rotated neighbor ranges causes duplicate slot publication or unwritten slot consumption.
